doc: world/feed-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: spectator-feed event schema, event vocabulary, and the demo seed set used by feed.html. The spectator feed is FREE forever (design §5) — it is the product's top of funnel, never metered.

event_schema.who: optional character id (C1–C8, A01–A20) or player handle on request events
event_schema.text: display text — surface-level only; never quotes interiors of homes, never secrets
event_schema.status: request events only: one of request_status
event_schema.req: optional, request events: shared request id — every lifecycle event of one paid intervention carries it; detail views group the status trail on it
event_schema.reason_code: optional, denied requests only: fixed enum from world/moderation.json (public sees the why-class, never the screened text beyond the display filter)
event_schema.attrs: optional: { surge, credits, minutes, compensated_cr, sponsors[], mentions[] } for transparency lines and follow matching; credits+minutes = the declared cost/duration shown at filing (design §11: action + duration declared upfront)

spectator_ui.doc: world v19 — the full spectator surface (world/wire.html, spec world/wire-ui.md). feed.html remains the lightweight variant.
spectator_ui.permalink: #e=<event id> deep-links one event; ids are stable live → archive (same id resolves in The Archive next day)
spectator_ui.request_threading: events sharing `req` render as one lifecycle trail (requested → in_review → approved → running → resolved/refunded/not approved)

follow_targets.v:<venue_id>: pin a venue — free spectator filter, reversible
follow_targets.c:<char_id>: pin a character (C/A/h ids) — public whereabouts only; a filter, never control

pagination.older: 'load older' extends the page in place — never a scroll jump
pagination.caught_up: 'You're caught up — nothing older than this today.'; earlier days route to The Archive
pagination.new_events: scrolled-away viewers see 'N new — jump to top'; the stream never moves text under a reader

spectator_ui_v33.doc: world v33 — lean-back + control polish on wire.html. Everything is view-layer only; no key, button, or pin can touch the world.
spectator_ui_v33.zen: lean-back theater view (button, `z` key, `#z=1`) — rails/upsell off, stream enlarged; view-layer only
spectator_ui_v33.hold: freezes the DISPLAY, never the world — events keep accruing behind an honest backlog bar ('the world didn't pause; the display did'); click or `h` releases
spectator_ui_v33.reaching_in_now: strip of live request cards (latest status ∈ requested/in_review/approved/queued/running) + recent admin actions, all attributed; a card opens the request's trail
spectator_ui_v33.keyboard: j/k select · enter detail · / search · f following · z zen · h hold · esc back out · ? help card
spectator_ui_v33.request_permalink: #r=<req> deep-links a request — resolves to the newest event in its lifecycle trail
spectator_ui_v33.mentions_ui: attrs.mentions[] render as pinnable chips in the detail panel; event who/venue get 'pin' buttons (view-layer follows only)

spectator_ui_v47.doc: world v47 — the recap layer on wire.html (v4). Still strictly view-layer: every number below is the feed's own events counted, never invented and never editorial.
spectator_ui_v47.day_so_far: collapsible card ('the day so far' bar / `d` key) — window covered, event count, busiest venue, requests filed/open/closed, weather changes, admin actions + total compensated credits; footer note states it is the wire counted, not a ranking
spectator_ui_v47.missed_bar: on join, a dismissible 'earlier today' bar summarizes everything already on the wire (count, requests, admin actions, latest sky) + 'catch me up' scrolls to the oldest pre-join event; pre-join timestamps render dimmed. No persistence, no fabricated personalization — it describes the feed as it stood at arrival
spectator_ui_v47.declared_costs: request rows carry 'N cr · M min' and the detail panel adds 'declared — N cr · M min (paid upfront, hard cap — shown at filing)' from attrs.credits/minutes; the price was public at filing and the wire repeats it
spectator_ui_v47.wx_follows_feed: the header weather line is set by the newest `weather` event (icon guessed from the event's own words — fog/rain/sun/wind/cloud); no fabricated temperature. Applies in demo and live modes alike

event_kinds: a named character changes venue (arrivals/departures — public routine only)
crowd-level note: fills, empties, line out the door
sky changes — including player-called weather, attributed
a player request lifecycle event (attributed — design §5 public request feed)
owner/admin action, always attributed, always with compensation note
Mission Unfiltered blog post — the blog is public; the author is a secret and never named
public registry events: move-in, listing posted/filled (never terms beyond posted rent)
a hired character joins the block — attributed to the hiring player; bio text only post-screen
honest-empty marker for dead dayparts — the feed may go quiet and says so
display_rules: surface-only: feed text is what a camera on the street could verify — no thoughts, no dialogue, no home interiors
homes render as 'home'/'headed home' — residential interiors are never a feed surface
secrets/drama seeds cannot appear: they are absent from the feed schema (structural, not filtered)
request text shown verbatim only after the §11 screen passes; denied text is never displayed
admin actions always carry compensation detail when players were affected
Mission Unfiltered posts carry no author — the author is a C1 secret and the feed does not speculate
viewer counts and timestamps are honest — no inflated social proof (no dark patterns)
